name: Illinois tax
title: Illinois Tax Calculator
desc: The Illinois tax calculator helps you estimate how much tax you will pay for 2026.

m.h: The period in which you want to see your take-home pay.
The standard number of dependent is one for single and two for married filer. State here only the number of additional dependent.

Set here the total of itemized deductions other than retirement contribution relevant to the federal income tax. If you don't set a deduction or it is less than the standard deduction, the standard deduction will be considered.

Set here the assessed value of your property reduced by the applied exemption. In general, taxpayers can claim a $6,000 exemption (General Homestead Exemption) on their principal residence (in Cook County, $10,000).
The value reflects the average effective property tax rate levied in the selected county. You can update the tax rate if necessary.

c: The estimated annual property tax is ${{prop_tax.formattedValue}}.
The estimated total annual tax is ${{annual_tax.formattedValue}}.
The estimated daily take-home pay is ${{fin_income_period.formattedValue}}.
The estimated weekly take-home pay is ${{fin_income_period.formattedValue}}.
The estimated bi-weekly take-home pay is ${{fin_income_period.formattedValue}}.
The estimated semi-monthly take-home pay is ${{fin_income_period.formattedValue}}.
The estimated monthly take-home pay is ${{fin_income_period.formattedValue}}.

* Effective tax rate (percentage of gross income). ** A credit of ${{credit.formattedValue}} deducted from the tax amount. FICA covers Social Security (${{soc_sec.formattedValue}}) and Medicare tax (${{med_care.formattedValue}}). Local tax includes Employment Training Tax (ETT) and State Disability Insurance (SDI) of ${{local_tax.formattedValue}}.

m.h: In percentage of gross income.

name: Loan balance
title: Loan Balance Calculator
desc: The loan balance calculator is a simple tool that is designed to calculate the remaining balance of your loan.

m.h: The time that has passed by since you took a loan.

eq.formula: loan_remaining = one_way((loan * (1 + interest_rate / 12) ^ period) - (loan * (1 + interest_rate / 12) ^ loan_term) * ((interest_rate / 12) / ((1 + interest_rate / 12) ^ loan_term -1)) * ((1 + interest_rate / 12) ^ period - 1) / (interest_rate / 12))

var.f: (pow(144, -period)*loan*(-pow(12, period)*pow(interest_rate + 12, loan_term + period) + pow(144, period)*pow(interest_rate + 12, loan_term) + (-pow(12, loan_term) + pow(interest_rate + 12, loan_term))*pow(12*interest_rate + 144, period))/(-pow(12, loan_term) + pow(interest_rate + 12, loan_term)))

name: Mortgage
title: Mortgage Calculator
desc: Mortgage calculator is a simple tool that helps you estimate the cost of your mortgage.

m.h: The purchase price of the property.
The total cash available for the house purchase.
If your down payment is lower than 20 percent of the house's value, you are obliged to pay Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI).
This is the value of your mortgage loan, in other words the loan principal.
Yearly rate of interest.

The length of time over which you are obliged to pay off your mortgage. Note that it is not equal to the amortization term (the actual time for the repayment of the principal), that is, you may pay off the whole principal amount before the end of the loan term. Possible options include an accelerated loan construction or extra payments.
You can set how often the bank calculate the interest on the principal balance.
Note that in the US, accelerated weekly and bi-weekly payments refer simply to the weekly and bi-weekly payments.
The first payment is due on this date.
The loan installment that you are obliged to pay at the due date of each agreed payment frequency (if you set extra periodic payment, the additional amount also appears here).

Here you can set an additional amount of money that you wish to contribute to your calculated loan installments. Note that after signing a mortgage contract you may charged for altering the amount of the installment stated in the contract.

Here you may set a percentage rate of growth in your payments that may reflect the average yearly increase of your income during the loan term. Note that you always should consult your bank before transferring any additional amount above your installment stated in the loan contract as most of the banks charge you an extra fee.
You can set here from which date onward you will add extra money to your installments (also including the yearly increase in payments).
Here you can set a one off payment to your mortgage on a specific date. Note that depending on your contract, the bank may charge you an extra fee for any advance payment.

This is the specific date when your individual prepayment is applied. Note that if the selected date doesn't coincide with the due date of your periodic payment, the amount will be added on the following payment due date.

Private Mortgage Insurance - this additional fee typically costs in the US between 0.5% to 1% of the entire loan amount on an annual basis. Note that after your home value to loan principal reaches a particular threshold (typically 20 percent) you can cancel this additional fee.
Currently the typical threshold of PMI in the US is 20 percent, still you may change it according to the specific loan construction.
Administered by the local government and utilized for road maintenance and costs of other public services. It is typically based on the value of the property.
An insurance policy that provides compensation for damage, loss or injury of property and it belongings in case of fire, theft or other accidents.
Homeowners association fee that covers the expenses of maintaining and improving the property.
You may set here any further costs that relate to your mortgage.

It is the total payment with additional costs you need to pay periodically. Note that although the due date of other expenses may divert from the payment frequency, here we rely on the due date of your loan installments.

The total of the {{payment_count.formattedValue}} mortgage payments is {{total_payment.monetaryValue}}. From that, the total interest payment is {{interest_paid.monetaryValue}}.

The total payable Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) is {{pmi_total.monetaryValue}}, with a {{pmi_html.monetaryValue}} periodic contribution, that needs to be paid until {{mortgage_payoff_pmi_date.formattedValue}}.

name: Mortgage calculator with extra payments
title: Mortgage with Extra Payments Calculator
desc: Use the mortgage with extra payments calculator to learn how paying extra on a mortgage affects your interest cost and repayment term.

m.h: The loan principal to be repaid on a monthly basis.
Yearly rate of interest.
Here, you can set how often the bank calculates interest on the principal balance.
The following due date.
Here you can set the date from which you will add extra money to your installments.
Here you can set a one-time single extra payment to your mortgage on a specific date.
Note, that if the set date doesn't coincide with your periodic payment due date, the extra payment is made on the following payment due date.

Here you may set the percentage rate of growth of your payments that may reflect the average yearly increase of your income during the loan term. Note, that you always should consult your bank before transferring any additional amount above your installment stated in the loan contract as most banks will charge you an extra fee.
Currently the typical PMI threshold in the USA is 20 percent. Still, you may change it according to the specific loan construction.
The loan installment that you are obliged to pay at the due date of each payment period (if you set an extra periodic payment, the additional amount also appears here).
